definitions.explanation: An angle measuring more than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.

examples.japanese: {鈍角|どんかく}は90{度|ど}より{大|おお}きく180{度|ど}より{小|ちい}さい。
examples.english: An obtuse angle is greater than 90 degrees and less than 180 degrees.

examples.japanese: この{三角形|さんかくけい}には{鈍角|どんかく}が{一|ひと}つある。
examples.english: This triangle has one obtuse angle.

notes:
{鈍角|どんかく} is an angle between 90 and 180 degrees.

ANGLE TYPES:
- {鋭角|えいかく}: acute angle (0° < θ < 90°)
- {直角|ちょっかく}: right angle (θ = 90°)
- {鈍角|どんかく}: obtuse angle (90° < θ < 180°)

RELATED TERMS:
- {鈍角|どんかく}{三角形|さんかくけい}: obtuse triangle
